title: Lightly Creamy Polish Dumplings Pierogi
description: A classic Polish dish featuring double cream and a tadka-spiced filling, perfect for meal prep.

ingredients.name: tadka spice mix (or garam masala, ground cumin, salt, black pepper to taste)

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour and warm water to form a dough.
Knead the dough for approximately 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of approximately 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
In a separate mixing bowl, combine the double cream, tadka spice mix, onion, potatoes, butter, egg, salt, and black pepper.
Place a tablespoon or two of the filling in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together with a fork to seal the pierogi.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and gently add the pierogi.
Cook for 5-7 minutes or until the pierogi float to the surface.
Serve hot with additional double cream and a sprinkle of tadka spice mix if desired.
